notes: Fly Cell Atlas (Li et al. 2022, Science; FBrf0252876), rebuilt from the authors' own per-tissue analyses (flycellatlas.org h5ad) and ArrayExpress (E-MTAB-10519 10x, E-MTAB-10628 Smart-seq2), one project per accession, replacing the old SCEA-based loads (FBlc0003846 / 4307 / 4785, split by sex). Curator decisions 2026-10-07: 10x Stringent per tissue + Smart-seq2 per tissue as complete sets (relaxed, integrated, cross-tissue and 'All' analyses left out); one Cluster per author annotation per tissue analysis. Samples from the ArrayExpress SDRF with curator-reviewed tissue terms (samples *overlap* RO:0002131 the tissue), FBdv stages and stocks from the supplement (only UAS-lamGFP has one: FBst0007378); Smart-seq2 fat body age corrected 3 -> 5 days per the supplement (sdrf_corrections). Mapping (FBbt 2026-10-01) once per author type (252 types, type_mapping/ in li_2022_fca_10x) and copied per cluster: 135 single current author cell terms confirmed by script (22 upgraded to the adult variant), 117 types via reports + map-clusters-to-fbbt subagents. Curator rules 2026-10-08: cell-level terms only (tissue/organ author terms -> cell-level term, else held); no narrowing by dissected tissue. Curator edits (manual_edit, 2026-10-13/14): adult antenna glial cell -> adult PNS glial cell; antimicrobial peptide-producing cell -> antimicrobial peptide-producing plasmatocyte; visceral muscle of the crop -> adult crop circular muscle cell; corpora cardiaca cell -> adult Akh secreting cell; posterior midgut* -> enterocyte of posterior adult midgut epithelium. Types: 175 exact, 65 broad, 1 narrow, 11 held (plus unannotated/artefact/unknown, held). Mapping reviewed by the curator 2026-10-14. No FBbt term requests. Expression (curator 2026-10-14: CPM for all datasets): CPM converted back from the authors' normalised h5ad values, level = mean over expressing cells, extent, filtered extent > 0.2. Genes keyed by symbol, FBgn from the 10x files where given, else by symbol in FlyBase Chado (FB2026_03). All FBbt/FBdv/FBcv terms verified current against the releases listed (2026-10-14). Publication FBrf0252876 resolved from VFB production (pdb). Smart-seq2 (E-MTAB-10628): 31 Samples (tissue x sex x genotype x age), 35 Assays (384-well plates), 17 Clusterings, 237 Clusters. The Smart-seq2 analyses carry only the authors' classifier labels (`transf_annotation`, label transfer from the 10x annotation; curator decision 2026-10-08: load the predicted-label groups, membership label_transfer, titled as not transcriptomic clusters); dilp2 IPC and Akh CC are FACS-sorted groups (fixed_annotation, membership sorted). Mappings shared with li_2022_fca_10x (type_mapping.from); 212 mapped to 109 distinct FBbt terms; 'unknown' groups held. Expression from X (log2(CPM + 1) -> CPM): 16,306 genes x 9,892 cells, 470,088 rows (dilp2IPC: authors dropped genes after normalising, some cells sum < 1e6 CPM); gene ids 16,203 current, 79 secondary, 26 synonym, 1 split + 2 unmatched dropped. Dataset total/filtered gene counts 16,293/15,011. 2026-10-14 (curator decision): clusters with no FBbt term (held) are no longer loaded - listed in mapping.tsv with a hold_reason, but given no VFBseq id (previously minted ids removed from the registry, never reused), no Cluster entity and no expression rows (their cells still count towards the Dataset's total/filtered gene counts, which measure what the experiment detected); 26 held entries (15 'unknown' = unassigned, 2 'artefact', 9 author types with no FBbt term) left out; 211 Clusters loaded; expression 426,111 rows (dataset total/filtered gene counts 16,293 / 15,011, unchanged). 2026-10-15: Assays named "<Sample>, Smart-seq2 plate <plate>" (previously the accession or library id); ids unchanged.
